questions.name: Business impact
questions.q: If this workflow ran much better, how much would it move a result that matters, such as pipeline, revenue, cost, speed or quality?
a: Little or no effect on results
Clear, large effect on a key result

questions.name: Effort and volume
questions.q: How much time and effort does this workflow take across the team?
a: Run constantly, a large share of team time

questions.name: Repeatability
questions.q: How consistent are the steps and outputs from one run to the next?
a: Same steps and outputs every run

questions.name: Data and content readiness
questions.q: Are the inputs (data, content, briefs, brand material) available, accurate and accessible to AI tools?

questions.name: Tool and integration readiness
questions.q: Are suitable AI-capable tools in place, or easy to add and connect to your current systems?
a: No suitable tools, hard to integrate
Tools exist but need setup or integration

questions.name: Consequence of an error
questions.q: If AI got a step wrong and nobody caught it, how serious would the consequence be?
a: Noticeable: rework, wasted spend or some reputational effect
Serious: legal, financial or major brand harm

questions.name: Data sensitivity
questions.q: How sensitive is the data or content this workflow handles?

tiers.name: Minimal
tiers.text: None of the other descriptions apply.

tiers.name: Limited (transparency)
tiers.text: AI talks to people as a chatbot, or generates or alters text, images, audio or video that people will see. Disclosure duties may apply.

tiers.name: High-risk
tiers.text: AI supports decisions about people in areas the Act lists, such as recruitment, worker management, education or access to essential services.

tiers.name: Prohibited
tiers.text: Uses a practice the Act bans, such as manipulating people, social scoring, or inferring employees' emotions.

quadrants.name: Prepare first
quadrants.text: High value, but not yet feasible. Close the gaps before building.

quadrants.name: Quick win
quadrants.text: Easier but lower value. Do when capacity allows.

quadrants.name: Park
quadrants.text: Lower value and not yet feasible. Revisit later.
